messages:
Sam: LAN this Saturday — thinking of bringing a couple of portable monitors to add extra screens. Anyone able to bring an HDMI switch or a USB-C -> Ethernet dongle? Also need a small router for split network / guest Wi-Fi.

Priya: I can bring a 3-port HDMI switch. Will it need power or is it passthrough? :slightly_smiling_face:

Jon: I have two USB-C ethernet dongles I can loan. Using a Mac til 8pm but they’ll be free after that.

Elena: Can someone bring a surge protector + long extension? Last time we had like 1 outlet between 6 people. :grimacing:

Marcus: I got a heavy-duty surge strip and a 15ft extension. I can bring both. Also happy to run a tiny DHCP box if needed (or just hand out sticky IPs) :robot_face:

Sam: Awesome Marcus, you’re the hero. Priya — passthrough, no extra power. Jon — perfect. Elena — can you label any adapters you bring? People tend to lose them.

Priya: Yup will label. Also can bring a few HDMI cables (short + long).

Jon: Quick PSA — please bring controllers fully charged and label them with your name. I’ll bring some velcro cable ties.

Elena: Pro tip: if you're bringing Switch docks, label the dock and the JoyCon grip separately. We lost one grip last time.

Sam: Basic schedule idea:
```
18:00 - doors open / setup
19:00 - Mario Kart lobby
20:30 - casual PC/coop (Cuphead, Left 4 Dead?)
22:30 - Smash tourney (if people down)
00:30 - wind down / cleanup
```

Marcus: Also quick poll — do we want background music? Vote: yes/no. If yes, low-volume chill playlist only.

Priya: yes

Jon: yes (but no heavy dubstep pls) :laughing:

Elena: no (trying to prep for Sunday call) :raised_hand:

Sam: Keeping it low volume. Also logistics: can someone bring a small TV stand or a coffee-table-surface for the projector?

Marcus: I can bring a folding table and a box of snacks (chips + salsa). Anyone allergic to nuts?

Priya: nut allergy in my household, safe to avoid.

Jon: I’ll bring some extra ethernet switches (gigabit) and a small travel router for guest split. IPs fine if sticky.

Sam: RSVP quick list (comment to add):
- Sam (hosts, monitors, projector if needed)
- Priya (HDMI switch, cables)
- Jon (dongles, ethernet switches)
- Marcus (surge, extension, table, snacks)
- Elena (controllers, labels)

Elena: Adding — I can also bring a couple of power banks for handhelds.

ops-bot: Reminder: event pinned in #random and calendar invite sent to @everyone. Please RSVP by Friday EOD. :calendar:

Sam: Cool — looks sorted. If anyone has a tiny HDMI-to-miniDP adapter, that’d help for my old laptop. Otherwise we’ll jury-rig. See you Saturday! :party_parrot:
